name: koalafix
description: Shared team memory and work items for Antigravity and the other AI tools your team uses. Hooks put the team's brief in front of each session and a recall of what you asked in front of each prompt; you sign in through the browser once. Needs Node.js 22 or later for the hooks.
suggestedPrompts: What does my team already know about this?
Who is working on what right now?
Remember this decision for the team
